description: Search public active WeJob job offers.

categories.description: Comma-separated category names, e.g. Développement & IT.

company.description: Company name filter, e.g. WeJob Sàrl.

employment_type.description: Comma-separated contract or workload: full_time, part_time, CDI, CDD, contract, internship, apprenticeship, freelance. French terms are accepted (temps plein, temps partiel, stage, alternance).

experience_level.description: Comma-separated level: junior, intermediate, senior, expert (entry, mid, confirmé, lead are accepted).

languages.description: Comma-separated language filter, for example Anglais, English, en.

location.description: City or canton, e.g. Genève, Vaud, Lausanne, Zurich. Comma-separate several places.

query.description: Free-text search over titles, descriptions, skills, companies and places. Words are OR-ed: one or two keywords work best, e.g. Java or data engineer.

salary_max.description: Maximum salary as a number, in the offer currency (CHF), e.g. 140000.

salary_min.description: Minimum salary as a number, in the offer currency (CHF), e.g. 100000.

skills.description: Comma-separated hard skills, e.g. Java, SQL. Only matches skills listed on the offer: prefer query for a broad search.

work_mode.description: Comma-separated work mode: on_site, hybrid, remote (sur site, hybride, télétravail are accepted).

name: wejob_search_jobs
title: Search WeJob jobs
